description: This PHP source file 'reqExport.php' is part of the TestLink project. It provides functionality for exporting requirements data in various formats (CSV and XML). It includes functions for initializing arguments and GUI settings, checking user rights, and handling the export process based on user actions. The file also manages dependencies and external references necessary for the export operations.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing the requirements export functionality.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters for the export operation.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI settings based on provided arguments and requirements manager.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the export action based on the selected export type and scope, outputs the data, and triggers file download.
